headline: LPS to Pay Claims of 17 Liquidated Banks in 2026
summary: LPS chairman Anggito Abimanyu announced claim payments for 17 rural banks (BPR and BPRS) whose licences were revoked by the OJK. LPS also has options for handling problem banks.
why: The Deposit Insurance Corporation protects depositors when banks fail, and its payouts affect confidence in Indonesia's banking system.
original_headline: LPS Bakal Bayar Klaim 17 Bank Likuidasi pada 2026
